description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDeliverList operation to query a list of all report tracking tasks
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDeliverList查询报表订阅任务列表，系统将返回所有的订阅任务列表
name: DescribeDcdnDeliverList

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tracking task that you want to query. If you do not specify this parameter, all tracking tasks are returned
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的订阅任务ID。如果不传该参数，默认返回所有的订阅任务
parameters.name: deliver_id

Content.description_en: The data of the tracking task list
Content.example: "data": [{"deliverId": 1,"status": "enable","createTime": "2021-06-14T11:19:26Z","crontab": "0 0 0 * * ?","frequency": "d","name": " domain name subscription","dmList": ["www.example.com"],"reports": [{"reportId": 1,"conditions": [{"op": "in","field": "prov","value": [" Heilongjiang"," Beijing"]}]},{"reportId": 2}],"deliver": {"email": {"subject": " topic","to": ["username@example.com","username@example.org"],"copy":["username@example.com","username@example.org"]}}}]}
